name: Landing Start Demo
description: The guided entry journey from the landing page through the board, platform guides, and the prepared Golden Initiative flow.

steps.title: Understand the board at a glance
steps.text: These cards summarize the Jira work items, workflow statuses, connected project, and live board source.

steps.title: Explore the initiative board
steps.text: The board brings synthetic Jira work items into one view so you can see where initiatives are in the governed journey.

steps.title: Ask Ciel for explanations
steps.text: Ciel can explain the current initiative, evidence, and decision context. Ciel assists and drafts; authorized people remain responsible for decisions.

steps.title: What Initiatives is for
steps.text: Product Owners use this page to capture business context, accountable ownership, scope, risk context, and success criteria before creating a Jira initiative. We are only exploring the page for now.

steps.title: Find other guided demos
steps.text: The Guided demos page contains focused tours for the general workbench and the prepared Golden Initiative flow. You can return here whenever you want another walkthrough.

steps.title: Experiment safely in Sandbox
steps.text: The Sandbox link opens a separate experimentation area for synthetic Jira searches and bounded scenarios. It is designed for safe tests, not production decisions.

steps.title: Find useful platform information
steps.text: Help center contains plain-language guides for evidence and lineage, risk and controls, human decisions, Jira integration, Ciel and AI, Sandbox usage, and guided demos.

steps.title: Begin the prepared Golden Initiative flow
steps.text: Load the synthetic remittance example so you can review the context and accountable owner. Nothing is created until the later confirmation step.

steps.title: Create it under Maya Chen
steps.text: The Golden Initiative is prepared with Maya Chen as the accountable Product Owner. Select Create initiative to open the final confirmation checkpoint.

steps.title: Confirm and create the Jira initiative
steps.text: Review the synthetic story and owner, then confirm. This is the authorized write that creates the Jira item.

steps.title: Confirm the Jira creation
steps.text: This status confirms the initiative was created in Jira and provides a link to open it there. We will continue in the FULCRUM view for the guided assessment.

steps.title: Continue in FULCRUM
steps.text: Open the newly created item in FULCRUM. The work item remains connected to Jira, while FULCRUM provides the governed evaluation workspace.

steps.title: Review the initiative context
steps.text: Scroll through the created initiative to review its summary, owner, description, labels, Jira status, and supporting context before evaluating it.

steps.title: FULCRUM evaluation
steps.text: This panel assesses whether the Jira initiative is ready for the current workflow stage using deterministic checks and AI decision support.

steps.title: Start the evaluation
steps.text: Select Evaluate Intake. This may take a moment while FULCRUM reviews multiple factors with automated checks and AI-supported analysis.

steps.title: Read the summary scores
steps.text: These summary cards show the weighted score, the recommendation, and how many checks passed. The final recommendation is decision support, not an automatic approval.

steps.title: Scoring configuration
steps.text: The scoring configuration shows the proceed threshold, partial-credit rule, and AI-versus-automatic weighting. A Risk Officer can update these values in Configuration, and each evaluation keeps a snapshot of what was used.

steps.title: Understand the AI response
steps.text: The AI response summarizes its recommendation, challenge, benefits, trade-offs, rationale, and Jira context. It is an explainable observation for a human reviewer, not an authoritative decision.

steps.title: Review the evaluation metrics
steps.text: The metric circles below show how each configured check performed and, where available, how the automatic and AI views contributed to the check result.

steps.title: Know when FULCRUM suggests the next step
steps.text: The proceed threshold is the configured score at which FULCRUM suggests moving to the next workflow area. An authorized person still makes the final decision.

steps.title: Publish the evaluation to Jira
steps.text: Publish the completed evaluation to add the governed result to the Jira work item. This creates the durable assessment record and Jira collaboration comment.

steps.title: Comments stay connected to Jira
steps.text: The comments area is integrated with Jira. The guided demo uses Maya's configured automation credential so the flow can demonstrate a real Jira comment without another sign-in interruption.

steps.title: Add a contextual comment
steps.text: A prepared synthetic comment is filled into the composer. Selecting Next will post it to the Jira initiative as a Fulcrum-bot review note; you do not need to click Post comment separately.

steps.title: Attachments provide supporting context
steps.text: Attachments give the evaluation additional initiative context. Uploading uses the current user's Jira authorization, just like posting a comment.

steps.title: Add the sample PDF
steps.text: Selecting Next will upload the Golden Initiative PDF as supporting context; you do not need to click Add sample PDF separately. You can replace this synthetic sample later with the proper document.

steps.title: Reassign the next stage
steps.text: Every stage move opens this reassignment dialog so accountability is explicit. Marcus Thompson is preselected as the next-stage owner. Confirm the assignment and transition.

steps.title: Context and Research is now active
steps.text: The status ribbon below the app bar now shows Context and Research. The Jira work item has moved forward and the next assessment is about research readiness.

steps.title: Maya is still signed in
steps.text: The current FULCRUM user is still Maya Chen, the Product Owner who created the initiative.

steps.title: Magically switch to Marcus Thompson
steps.text: For this synthetic walkthrough, we will switch the active demo persona to Marcus Thompson without leaving the story. In a real deployment, each person signs in normally.

steps.title: Evaluate the Context and Research stage
steps.text: The same FULCRUM evaluation surface now assesses the Context and Research stage rather than Intake.

steps.title: Evaluate the research stage
steps.text: Selecting Next will run the Context and Research assessment. The metrics and AI response will be recalculated for this stage.

steps.title: Stage-specific metric circles
steps.text: These metric circles now represent Context and Research checks, such as evidence completeness, partner context, and research ownership.

steps.title: Publish the research assessment
steps.text: Selecting Next will publish the Context and Research assessment to Jira.

steps.title: Add supporting research context
steps.text: We can attach supporting analysis to the same Jira initiative before reassessing the stage.

steps.title: Attach the sample Excel analysis
steps.text: Selecting Next will attach Golden Initiative - risk-analysis.xlsx from the public demo folder. Replace that file later with the final workbook.

steps.title: Add Maya's additional context
steps.text: Maya's follow-up notes add operational details about limits, alert ownership, partner diligence, and escalation. These comments can help satisfy the remaining stage metrics.

steps.title: Post two Maya discussion notes
steps.text: Selecting Next will persist two additional synthetic comments as Maya Chen through the guided-demo Jira automation connection.

steps.title: Reassess with the new context
steps.text: Selecting Next will reassess Context and Research using the new workbook and comments. This may take a moment.

steps.title: Publish the updated research assessment
steps.text: Selecting Next will publish the updated stage assessment so the new context is recorded in Jira.

steps.title: Move to Risk Assessment
steps.text: The updated research assessment is ready to move forward. Select the highlighted move action to open the reassignment checkpoint.

steps.title: Assign Risk Assessment to Priya Shah
steps.text: Priya Shah is preselected as the FCRM Analyst who will own the Risk Assessment stage. Confirm the assignment and transition.

steps.title: Risk Assessment is now active
steps.text: The Jira status ribbon now shows Risk Assessment. This is where the initiative's risk factors, controls, and residual exposure are reviewed.

steps.title: Switch to Priya Shah
steps.text: The active demo persona is now Priya Shah, an FCRM Analyst. She can evaluate risk and manage approved configuration, but she cannot create new initiatives.

steps.title: Open Configuration as Priya
steps.text: Priya's role can access Configuration even though the Initiatives section is not available to her. Configuration changes are persisted without redeploying.

steps.title: Risk rating boundaries
steps.text: The S1 and S2 handles define the Low, Medium, and High residual-risk ranges. S1 and S2 stay separated so the bands cannot overlap.

steps.title: Control mitigation strength
steps.text: This value is the maximum number of score points that fully effective controls can remove. A lower value is stricter; a higher value is more lenient.

steps.title: Learn more about risk scoring
steps.text: The explanation connects the starting risk score, control effectiveness, mitigation cap, and S1/S2 rating bands. It is a guide to the deterministic calculation, not an AI decision.

steps.title: AI and AutoScore weighting
steps.text: AutoScore comes from deterministic checks. The AI score is advisory analysis of the same context. The weighting combines them into readiness support; it does not approve or reject the initiative.

steps.title: Set the next-step threshold to 50
steps.text: Selecting Next will save a proceed threshold of 50. After an assessment, FULCRUM shows the next-stage recommendation when the final score reaches this value, while a human still confirms the move.

steps.title: Return to the same FCRM story
steps.text: We are returning to the Golden Initiative story we created earlier. Remember its key: use the status ribbon and summary to confirm we are still assessing the same Jira work item.

steps.title: Evaluate the Risk Assessment stage
steps.text: The evaluation panel now assesses risk-stage readiness using the current configuration snapshot, including the threshold saved by Priya.

steps.title: Evaluate the risk stage
steps.text: Selecting Next will run the Risk Assessment evaluation. The metric circles will show the risk-stage checks.

steps.title: Review the risk-stage metrics
steps.text: These circles now assess risk-stage evidence, control coverage, ownership, and other configured readiness checks.

steps.title: Publish the Risk Assessment
steps.text: Selecting Next will publish the Risk Assessment result to Jira.

steps.title: Move to Review
steps.text: The risk-stage result is ready for committee review. Select the highlighted move action to open the reassignment checkpoint.

steps.title: Assign Review to Helen Morgan
steps.text: Helen Morgan is preselected as the Risk Committee officer for the Review stage. Confirm the assignment and transition.

steps.title: Review is now active
steps.text: The status ribbon now shows Review. The initiative has reached the stage where an authorized Risk Committee officer can make the final human decision.

steps.title: Magically switch to Helen Morgan
steps.text: The active demo persona is now Helen Morgan. Her Risk Committee role gives her the entitlement to record the final accept or reject decision.

steps.title: Add Risk Officer analysis
steps.text: We will return to the attachment area and add the Risk Officer analysis as supporting context. The guided automation uploads it using Maya Chen's configured Jira account.

steps.title: Attach the Risk Officer analysis
steps.text: Selecting Next will upload a synthetic Risk Officer analysis attachment to Jira using Maya's guided-demo automation credential.

steps.title: Use previous stage summaries
steps.text: The previous stage summaries provide the committee with a compact record of what was assessed, when it was published, and what recommendation was made at each stage.

steps.title: Only the Risk Committee decides
steps.text: The Human decision section makes the governance boundary explicit: AI and automated checks provide support, but only an authorized Risk Committee officer can accept or reject the overall initiative.

steps.title: Review the final-stage evaluation
steps.text: Before a decision can be recorded, Review needs its own current-stage evaluation.

steps.title: Evaluate Review
steps.text: Selecting Next will assess the Review stage. This may take a moment while the final-stage metrics are calculated.

steps.title: Review the final metrics
steps.text: These metric circles show the Review-stage readiness checks that support the committee decision.

steps.title: Publish the Review result
steps.text: Selecting Next will publish the Review evaluation to Jira so the committee has a durable assessment record.

steps.title: Prepare the human decision
steps.text: Helen can now review the evidence, stage summaries, controls, and final evaluation. The guided demo pre-fills an acceptance rationale based on the Golden Initiative context.

steps.title: Record the human decision
steps.text: Selecting Next will record Helen Morgan's accepted decision with the prepared rationale and transition the Jira initiative to Accepted.

steps.title: Verify the complete Jira record
steps.text: Open in Jira to verify that the initiative, stage transitions, assignments, evaluations, comments, attachments, and final decision were persisted. This completes the assisted demo.

name: Welcome Tour
description: A guided orientation to the workbench, decision lineage, risk controls, Jira context, and Ciel.

steps.title: Start with the dashboard
steps.text: Ask Ciel can explain the current workbench, while Welcome tour walks through the decision journey. Both actions stay inside the governed demo workspace.

steps.title: Live Jira board
steps.text: This board reflects the current synthetic FCRM work items and workflow status from Jira.

steps.title: At-a-glance context
steps.text: These summary cards show item volume, workflow coverage, the connected project, and whether the board is live.

steps.title: Formulate an initiative
steps.text: Product Owners start with a decision-ready business change. Capture the owner, outcome, scope, affected users, risk context, and success criteria before creating work in Jira.

steps.title: Find the deeper information in Help center
steps.text: The Help center contains focused guides for Evidence & lineage, Risk & controls, Human decisions, Jira integration, Ciel and AI, Sandbox usage, and Guided demos. Use those topics whenever you want the explanation behind a workspace feature.

steps.title: Ask Ciel
steps.text: Use Ciel, the FULCRUM AI Assistant, to explore the current initiative and decision context. Ciel explains and drafts; authorized humans decide.

name: Create the Golden Initiative
description: Walk through creating the synthetic Launch U.S.–Philippines Instant Remittance initiative from a prepared business context.

steps.title: Create a decision-ready initiative
steps.text: This guided flow uses the same formulation surface a Product Owner uses to prepare a new FCRM initiative. Nothing is written until you explicitly confirm it.

steps.title: Load the golden flow
steps.text: Click “Load Golden Initiative” to populate the synthetic Launch U.S.–Philippines Instant Remittance example. You can inspect or edit every field before continuing.

steps.title: Start with the business change
steps.text: The summary becomes the Jira work-item title. The golden flow describes a cross-border instant-remittance launch with a clear product and geographic change.

steps.title: Add governed context
steps.text: Review the problem, outcome, scope, affected users, risk considerations, and success criteria. These fields create the context FULCRUM evaluates later.

steps.title: Review the write action
steps.text: Choose “Create initiative” when the context is ready. The confirmation dialog is the final checkpoint before the Jira write.

steps.title: Confirm the synthetic write
steps.text: Confirm only when the story and accountable owner look right. The server-side Jira adapter creates the work item, assigns the owner, and verifies the Jira result.
